description: Send a test event to a webhook endpoint to verify it is reachable and correctly configured. Takes an event_type (e.g. comment.received) and a raw JSON payload. Returns the delivery result including HTTP response code and any error. Does not charge the user's event quota. Use this during setup to confirm your endpoint validates the signature correctly.

payload.description: JSON payload to send as the event body

webhook_id.description: Webhook endpoint ID to send test payload to

name: social_api_test_webhook
title: Test Webhook
